title: With an Intel recovery underway, all eyes turn to its foundry business
description: Intel added $20 billion to its balance sheet in Q3 but didn't offer many details on the progress of its floundering foundry business.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: OpenAI buys Sky, an AI interface for Mac
description: OpenAI has acquired Software Applications, Inc., the startup behind Sky — an AI-powered natural language interface for Mac that can view your screen and take actions in your apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: 20-year-old dropouts built AI notetaker Turbo AI and grew it to 5 million users
description: Rudy Arora and Sarthak Dhawan, two 20-year-old college dropouts, grew an AI note-taker app to five million users and an eight-figure ARR, they say.
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: Instagram users can now use Meta AI editing tools directly in IG Stories
description: Meta AI's photo editing tools can be found in Instagram Stories when tapping the paintbrush icon. Users can describe what they want to add, remove, or change.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Two days after OpenAI’s Atlas, Microsoft relaunches a nearly identical AI browser
description: Copilot Mode of Microsoft's Edge browser is the company's take on the long-hyped AI browser category.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Microsoft’s Mico is a ‘Clippy’ for the AI era
description: Microsoft has unveiled “Mico,” a new animated avatar for its Copilot AI that brings back shades of Clippy. The expressive blob acts as a friendly, customizable face for the chatbot.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Tensormesh raises $4.5M to squeeze more inference out of AI server loads
description: Tensormesh uses an expanded form of KV Caching to make inference loads as much as ten times more efficient.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Palantir enters $200M partnership with telco Lumen to offer enterprise AI services
description: Palantir said on Thursday it had struck a partnership with Lumen Technologies that will see the telecommunications company using the data management company's AI software to build capabilities to support enterprise AI services.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Sora update to bring AI videos of your pets, new social features, and soon, an Android version
description: OpenAI’s hit AI video app, Sora, is getting a wave of new features, including video editing tools, pet and object “cameos,” and enhanced social options. The Android app is also “coming soon."
author: Sarah Perez

title: Cluely’s Roy Lee joins TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 to show how rage-baiting cuts through the AI noise
description: Cluely’s Roy Lee isn’t afraid to stir the pot — and he’s taking that bold energy to the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025, happening October 27–29 at San Francisco’s Moscone West. Register now to join, and save up to $444 on your pass + 60% off a second.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Wonder Studios, backed by OpenAI, DeepMind execs, raised $12M to bring AI content to Hollywood
description: Wonder will use the fresh funds to double its engineering team and accelerate its push into IP ownership and original content production.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Get hands-on: The full lineup of interactive roundtables at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description: TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 roundtables bring founders, investors, and operators together for interactive small-group discussions on AI, fintech, space, and more. Check the full schedule, and don’t miss your chance to save up to $444 and 60% off a second pass before prices rise at the door.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Only 4 days until TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 kicks off in San Francisco and ticket rates increase
description: The wait all year is almost over! In just 4 days, TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 takes over San Francisco's Moscone West and with it the future of tech. This is your final chance to join the founders, investors, and innovators shaping the future before ticket prices increase. Save up to $444 + 60% on a second pass now.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Amazon’s new AI shopping tool tells you why you should buy a recommended product
description: Amazon's new Help Me Decide tool will show you a personalized recommendation for a particular category and list reasons why you should buy it.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Snapchat makes its first open prompt AI Lens available for free in the US
description: Snapchat is expanding access to its AI-powered “Imagine Lens,” allowing all users to generate and edit images with custom prompts for free.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Why Cohere’s ex-AI research lead is betting against the scaling race
description: Cohere's former VP of AI research, Sara Hooker, is launching a new startup to build AI models that can adapt to their environment.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: OpenAI requested memorial attendee list in ChatGPT suicide lawsuit
description: The new information comes as the Raines family updated its lawsuit against OpenAI. The family first filed a wrongful death suit against OpenAI in August after alleging their son had taken his own life following conversations with the chatbot about his mental health and suicidal ideation.
author: Rebecca Bellan
